description: This file contains utility functions for handling JSON schemas, including conversion to form fields, validation, default value extraction, and example data generation, specifically for dynamic form generation and schema processing in a web client context.

methods.name: schemaToFormFields
methods.description: Converts a JSON schema into an array of form fields for dynamic form generation.

methods.name: validateFormData
methods.description: Validates form data against a JSON schema using Zod for schema validation.

methods.name: validateValueAgainstSchema
methods.description: Validates a single value against its JSON schema.

methods.name: generateExampleData
methods.description: Generates example data conforming to a given JSON schema.
